# Read Primitives — Decimal Arithmetic

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Decimal precision arithmetic with complex expressions

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* decimal precision arithmetic with complex expressions */
SELECT
  l_orderkey,
  l_extendedprice * (
    1 - l_discount
  ) * (
    1 + l_tax
  ) AS final_price,
  l_extendedprice / l_quantity AS unit_price
FROM lineitem
WHERE
  l_quantity > 0
LIMIT 1000
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def decimal_arithmetic_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Decimal precision arithmetic with complex expressions."""
    col, lit = ctx.col, ctx.lit
    return (
        ctx.get_table("lineitem")
        .filter(col("l_quantity") > lit(0))
        .select(
            col("l_orderkey"),
            (col("l_extendedprice") * (lit(1) - col("l_discount")) * (lit(1) + col("l_tax"))).alias("final_price"),
            (col("l_extendedprice") / col("l_quantity")).alias("unit_price"),
        )
        .limit(1000)
    )
```
